title: Independent Multi-Level Drainage Exchange Aggregation Qualification

legacy_authority.aggregation_semantics: qdrtot initialized to zero and accumulated qdrain(level) sequentially for level=1..nrlevs
legacy_authority.legacy_capacity_context: MADR is a compile-time capacity, historically 5 for MultiSWAP and 25 standalone; it is not a physical law

qualification_scope.legacy_equivalence: ordered total-flux aggregation for legacy-admitted level counts, with exact constituent values supplied to the aggregator
qualification_scope.modern_sensitivity_composition: sum dq/dgwl only when all constituent derivatives are defined and finite; otherwise preserve valid flux and mark derivative unavailable
qualification_scope.branch_metadata: conservative union/count of branch-boundary and singular-tangent metadata
qualification_scope.scalability_extension: dynamic counts above legacy MADR are architecture qualification only, not B1.10 equivalence
qualification_scope.mass_semantics: aggregate total is a derived view of constituent transfers and does not authorize double ledger booking

required_checks: frozen drainage source identity from manifest
no src/reference changes on qualification branch
independent randomized legacy-range sequential summation for level counts 1..25, including 1..5 MultiSWAP range
mixed signed constituent arithmetic without qualifying the generating negative-side physics
unavailable or nonfinite constituent tangent preserves valid flux and makes aggregate derivative unavailable
branch-boundary and singular-tangent metadata compose conservatively
dynamic level counts above 25 are supported as a scalability extension
holds: No qualification of DRAMET=3 negative-side infiltration response physics.
No runtime mass-ledger or rollback/commit qualification.
No solver Jacobian or fully implicit drainage qualification.
